_comment: EXAMPLE VALUES: the time window and operator name below are placeholders; replace every value before real use. Copy to your survey scope file and pass with --scope-file. Fill every required field. The Night Watchman records the SHA-256 of this file and, for JSON scopes, notes whether the run start fell inside the window and whether the operator is listed. Warnings are the default; --strict-scope refuses to start on a mismatch.
location: Building / floor / room or outdoor area covered by the ROE
notes: Optional free-text notes. The ROE must say whether bystander metadata may be collected and for how long it is kept.
